Team —

Following up on the kernel/runtime hiring slate we discussed in staffing sync. HireBridge sent an exceptional candidate for the runtime kernel SRE role (Priya Desai). Priya is a strong hire: 8+ years systems background, prior work on KV cache consistency at scale, and shipped attention-kernel improvements at her last company. Landon attached the resume and an initial compensation suggestion.

Request: I need approval to (a) allocate one senior slot to runtime-kernel (this will pull from the infra pool) and (b) approve a one-band offer exception for Priya at the top of Senior II range (~$215k base + competitive equity). The slate-level impact: we convert a planned mid-level opening to senior; net headcount stays within the Q2 tranche if leadership signs off on this swap.

Why the exception? Priya brings immediate domain expertise that would likely reduce ramp time by 3-4 months and will own KV caching and kernel optimizations needed for our low-latency SLOs. The attached "seniority-band-justification.docx" summarizes quantifiable impact and LT costs.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly / Karthik: quick approval or counter (band or pool trade) by end of day Tuesday so we can move to verbal offer.
- Landon: stand by to prepare formal offer packet once we have internal greenlight.

Thanks —
Mateo
